title: Known-truth factorial response compiler and path camera calibration
question: Can a finite frozen compiler family predict target effect A, preserve legitimate context B, recover interaction J, reject nuisance and wrong identity, close a two-stage path, and abstain when the response is unidentifiable?

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Held-out compiler type, A1, B, J, identity, nuisance, path and manifold metrics.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: All seven truth families are typed exactly, including abstention, and every applicable confirmation gate passes in both registry splits.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: Any family is mistyped or any frozen confirmation gate fails.

hypothesis_predictions.observable: The same held-out factorial response and path battery.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: A finite response compiler cannot jointly preserve B, predict J and abstain under hidden collisions.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: Exact type recovery and all applicable gates pass across both splits.

data_contract.cluster_unit: One private mechanism family with one registry split, task and replicate identity.
data_contract.split_rule: Calibration and family-holdout registries are independently seeded; confirmation neither selects compiler type nor changes thresholds.
data_contract.answer_payload_rule: Private mechanism labels are unavailable until adjudication; abstention systems remain in the denominator.

metrics.estimator: Exact compiler and abstention type recovery.
Relative A1, B and J response error.
Wrong identity, nuisance sensitivity and control separation.
Stage-local handoff, block, rescue and wrong rescue.
95th-percentile distance to the registered natural target state.

typed_gates.rule: Compiler and abstention type accuracy equal one across all 336 systems.
Every actionable system passes frozen A1, B and J thresholds.
Every actionable system rejects wrong identity and nuisance while all negative controls exceed their floor.
Every actionable system passes stage-local handoff, block, correct rescue and wrong-identity rescue.
Every system passes within both independent registry splits.

budget.right_censoring_rule: Any type or conjunctive gate failure stops C012 before free-network or pretrained-model execution.

stopping_rules: No private family label is exposed before adjudication.
No candidate, width, bandwidth, threshold or family changes after preregistration.
Pass does not authorize Qwen3 or a language claim.

adjudication.failure_claim: Type recovery was 331/336 because five smooth-local systems were already sufficient under earlier linear or quadratic candidates, and two actionable systems failed the manifold tail gate. The result rejects this exact generative-family type gate and blocks external validity; it does not reject conditional mechanisms generally.

authorizes_on_pass: one separately frozen free-trained cross-depth Transformer factorial compiler phase
